generalized_procrustes — SHAPESTAT procrustes op

• Data kinds: shapeset → shapeset

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.generalized_procrustes(shapes, max_iter: 'int' = 100, tol: 'float' = 1e-10, scaling: 'bool' = True, reflection: 'bool' = False) (to call the implementation directly, import shapestats; shapestats.generalized_procrustes(shapes, max_iter: 'int' = 100, tol: 'float' = 1e-10, scaling: 'bool' = True, reflection: 'bool' = False); from the registry, opsshapestat.get("generalized_procrustes"))

Usage

Generalised Procrustes analysis (GPA). Brings all individuals into a common frame. → (K, N, 3).

The procedure is the textbook one: take 1 individual as a provisional mean, align everyone, recompute the mean, re-align that mean to the first individual to stop the frame from drifting, and repeat until convergence. Without that last step the mean rotates slowly every time and never reaches tol.

Convergence is judged by how much the mean shape moves (per-point RMS). The iteration count and whether it converged are returned neither by shape_mean nor by this function -- since it is a function returning the group, when you need diagnostics, measure procrustes_distance before and after.
